sheets.prompt: Production asset sheet for the supplied reference mockup's MINIMAL fantasy pawn game. Reference image is STYLE reference only, do NOT reproduce its UI or screenshot. Clean smooth flat 2D, bold charcoal outline, solid color blocks with at most one shadow tone, very few interior lines. No pixel art, no gradients, no painted texture, no realistic anatomy, no fine details, no decorative frames, no labels, no text, no watermark. Must remain legible at 32-48 pixels per asset. Create exactly SIX separate unarmed fantasy pawn BASE sprites in a perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows atlas, square image, transparent background with genuine alpha. Each pawn centered at same bottom baseline within its cell with large clear padding. Head and simple torso silhouette ONLY, no arms or legs, round head just above body, face blank, no eyes mouth or nose. All wear the SAME plain warm-gray sleeveless tunic, no hats helmets armor weapons jewelry or accessories. Front-facing consistent slightly top-down pawn perspective. Top row: human with light tan round head and minimal brown hair cap, average torso; elf pale peach head with clearly projecting pointed ears and a simple blonde hair cap, slim torso; dwarf tan broad head with ONE blocky orange beard shape, short broad torso. Bottom row: orc olive-green broad head, two tiny ivory tusk triangles at lower head corners, broad shoulders; beastkin warm tawny catlike head with TWO triangular animal ears and a tiny cream muzzle patch, average torso, no tail; goblin light green smaller head with two large long pointed ears, small thin torso. These are species bases without class equipment, distinct chiefly by shape and skin color, cute and simple, neutral standing idle. Uniform thick outline. Each cell contains exactly one pawn, no extra drawings.

Walls chunky planar shapes, minimal seam marks. Make floors usable as repeatable modules, no cast shadows bleeding across tile borders. NO character, prop chest, UI, lighting effects or torch. Entire image is the tile atlas and NOTHING else.
